definitions: The state or process of a species, family, or larger group ceasing to exist.
The act of extinguishing or the state of being extinguished.
The disappearance of a conditioned response when the unconditioned stimulus is no longer presented with the conditioned stimulus.
examples: The dodo's extinction was caused by human activity.
Firefighters worked to prevent the extinction of the blaze.
The extinction of the fear response was gradual.
